PC: Place patient on positive pressure ventilation (BiPAP, CPAP, or intubation)
Obtain labs including VBG, K, troponin
Give medications for temporizing hyperkalemia (insulin, albuterol, and/or bicarb)
Give medication to eliminate potassium (furosemide or kayexalate)
ICS: One learner designates himself or herself as the team leader and assigns roles to the other team members (one person for airway, one person to act as bedside nurse, one person to obtain history/exam).
All learners use closed-loop communication throughout the scenario.
The team leader demonstrates situation awareness and clearly allocates resources and tasks throughout the scenario.
